CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_profile_role(target_profile_id uuid, target_role account_role, target_full_name text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ begin if not public.is_developer() then raise exception 'Apenas um administrador developer pode alterar cargos'; end if; update public.profiles set role = target_role, full_name = case when nullif(trim(target_full_name), '') is null then full_name else trim(target_full_name) end where id = target_profile_id; if not found then raise exception 'Conta não encontrada'; end if; return true; end; $function$

policies_access_requests.with_check: ((lower(email) = lower((auth.jwt() ->> 'email'::text))) AND (requested_role = ANY (ARRAY['parent'::account_role, 'student'::account_role, 'pedagogical'::account_role, 'monitor'::account_role, 'gatekeeper'::account_role])) AND (approved_role IS NULL) AND (status = 'pending'::request_status) AND (reviewed_by IS NULL) AND (reviewed_at IS NULL))

(is_developer() AND (requested_role = ANY (enum_range(NULL::account_role))) AND ((approved_role IS NULL) OR (approved_role = requested_role)) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::request_status, 'approved'::request_status, 'rejected'::request_status])))

(is_developer() AND (requested_role = ANY (enum_range(NULL::account_role))) AND (((approved_role IS NULL) AND (status = 'pending'::request_status)) OR ((approved_role = requested_role) AND (status = 'approved'::request_status))))
